description: DB-backed: the ticket list query with where ticket_id in [a, b] returns only readable tickets among a and b, ignoring other scope filters supplied by focus mode; a ticket the caller cannot read is omitted
Where validation refuses a ticket_id clause with more than 200 values
matchesTicketListChange returns true/false (never null) for an event when filters carry a ticket_id clause

ChangedSinceLoad: with new and updated entries, acknowledge('new') clears only new; ticketIds('updated') still returns the updated IDs; a later event is still classified against the full-list snapshot
DB-backed: getTicketChangeCounts returns newTicketIds for authorized matching tickets changed by another user after the cutoff, excludes the caller's own changes, and caps at 200
ChangedSinceLoad fallback snapshot exposes newTicketIds through ticketIds('new')

Dashboard: clicking 'N new' fetches with only the ticket_id clause, keeps the updated count, and leaves URL, activeFilters and saved-view capture unchanged; 'Show all tickets' restores the original request
Dashboard: 'Refresh list' while focused refetches with the full list's filters and clears counts
Dashboard: changing a filter while focused leaves focus and applies the change to the original filters
Select-all-matching while focused requests IDs with the focused filters
i18n: every tickets locale file carries the new banner and focus-notice keys
